tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything; the code canvas and terminal sit on it.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: App chrome: sidebar, top bar, bottom tab bar.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Cards and panels (Activité en cours, Agents actifs, PR list).

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Raised: inputs, chips, row hover, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item, pressed state. Keep ink-faint text off it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, tab outline): 3:1 on bg-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and code, on every bg-* in both themes (11:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, on every bg-* (5.8:1+).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary labels, line numbers, comments, on bg-000…bg-300 only (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand and 'alive': primary action, running agent, success, progress fill, focus ring. As text on bg-000…bg-300 and mint-soft.

tokens.name: mint-strong
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed fill of mint.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind mint text: live pills, approved card.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Label and icons on a mint or mint-strong fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: 'Needs you': approvals, review requested. As text on bg-000…bg-300 and amber-soft; never for decoration.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the approval card and 'À relire' pills.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Label on an amber fill (the Approuver button).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: 'Queued / waiting' (En attente) and links. Text on bg-* and sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind sky text.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Failure: failed check, crash, deleted lines. Always with a word or icon. Text on bg-* and coral-soft.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind coral text.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added-line ground in diffs; ink reads on it at 12:1+.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Deleted-line ground in diffs; ink reads on it at 14:1+.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Code: keywords (public, await, return). On bg-000…bg-300 and the diff grounds.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Code: string literals.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Code: types and class names.

tokens.name: syn-fn
tokens.usage: Code: method calls.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Code: comments — an alias of ink-faint.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Code: numbers and constants — an alias of amber.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist, hosted on Google Fonts. Tight, technical, calm enough for eight hours.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Greeting and page titles; one per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The current task's title, PR titles in detail views.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Implémentation de la synchronisation automatique des sauvegardes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Pills, chips, buttons in compact rows.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for code, diffs, terminal, ticket keys and counters (tabular).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Dot-to-label, icon-to-label in pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and rows; between rows of a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (default).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; between page sections.

radius.note: Soft rectangles; pills only for status.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Repo chips, code badges, diff file rows.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, tab pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and list containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, the hero task card, sheets on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, dots, avatars, progress tracks.

shadow.note: Dark theme leans on glow, not drop shadow: light comes from the thing that is alive.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest (light theme mostly).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sheets.

tokens.name: glow-mint
tokens.usage: Primary button hover; the card of a running session.

tokens.name: glow-amber
tokens.usage: Peak of the approval card's attention breathe.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ground gap then 2px solid mint (4.9:1+ on every bg). Never animated.

duration.note: Seven speeds. UI feedback under 250ms; loops only for living things.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Hover colour, row highlight, icon tint.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Press, toggle, exits, tooltips.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Tab indicator, nav rail, pill state change, list item enter.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panels, sheets, progress fill steps, card state morph.

tokens.name: dur-deliberate
tokens.usage: Celebrations only: approved, all tests green, check draw.

tokens.name: dur-shimmer
tokens.usage: Progress flow, skeleton, the one-shot nudge sweep.

tokens.name: dur-ambient
tokens.usage: Breathing loops: live dot ring, attention breathe, avatar orbit.

tokens.name: stagger-step
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings entering (rows, checklist items). Cap at 8 steps.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Anything that moves from one resting state to another (tab indicator, width).

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Elements arriving: fast start, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving: slow start, gone fast.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Your own actions only: press release, approve, check pop. Overshoots ~10%.

tokens.name: ease-breathe
tokens.usage: Ambient loops (sine-like in and out).

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Rotations and flowing stripes.

travel.note: How far things move. Short distances keep motion legible at speed.

tokens.name: shift-1
tokens.usage: Hover nudge (chevrons, arrows).

tokens.name: shift-2
tokens.usage: Pills and chips entering.

tokens.name: shift-3
tokens.usage: Rows, cards, messages entering.

tokens.name: shift-4
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets entering.
